narrative:
Ottawa County has 29,802 registered voters, with 19.7% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 29.3% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 43.1%, a pronounced Democratic lean of 13.8 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 36.7% of registrants.
